data_fields.name: parallel_success_threshold
data_fields.donor_constant: -1 (all children; skipped children count as success)

best_idea: A per-NPC priority list re-walked from the top every tick, where a higher child that starts RUNNING halts the lower ones and each guard is an explicit node, so an ability choice can interrupt a running action without a hidden timer.
decision_why: Take the reactive priority selector and a guard checked every tick; drop the XML, script-string and blackboard runtime, which is too heavy per NPC on a small server; fix the stale precondition latch (guards re-checked every tick, no latch).
acceptance: A test NPC with the priority list attack while hp > 30%, else back off switches to back-off on the first tick its hp falls to 30% or below, and after a halt the guard is checked again on the next tick (no stale state).
